headline: Sensex jumps 900 points, Nifty tops 22,500 as TCS and IT stocks lead a broad market recovery

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: TCS reported strong Q2 earnings, leading to a 4-5% surge in its share price.
The Nifty IT index ended its four-day losing streak with a 3% gain.
Positive sentiment returned to the market with all sectoral indices turning green.
Auto stocks gained over 1.5%, contributing to the overall market strength.
whatHappening: Sensex and Nifty recovered significantly from previous sessions, with Sensex gaining nearly 900 points.
Redington shares are under pressure following reports of Apple scaling back iPhone 18 Pro orders.
Gold and silver prices surged sharply, with gold rising by over Rs 2,000.
Anand Rathi shares slipped nearly 4% ahead of its earnings announcement.
summary: Indian markets surged on October 9, 2026, with the Sensex gaining nearly 900 points and Nifty topping 22,500. The rally was spearheaded by a 5% jump in TCS shares following its Q2 results, which triggered a 3% rise in the IT index. While most sectors gained, Redington and Anand Rathi faced downward pressure due to order cuts and pre-earnings caution.
